description:
Use only with the user's own likeness or content they are authorized to use. Do not use for impersonation, deception, sexual content, or content involving minors.

MCP guidance:
- Starts an async image job; returns `id` and `credits_charged`. For finished results, call `wait_for_image_project` with that id or poll `GET /v1/image-projects/{id}` until `complete`, `error`, or `canceled`. Results include `downloads`; wait helpers add `exact_download_urls`. Preserve signed URLs and query parameters; never append expiration metadata.
- For `*_file_path`, use an existing Magic Hour path or the upload-URL endpoint's `file_path` after uploading raw bytes to its presigned URL. Direct public media URLs may work if stable and fetchable as raw bytes; hotlinked URLs can fail. Prefer the upload-URL endpoint when unsure.

Change outfits in photos in seconds with just a photo reference. Each photo costs 25 credits.

assets.description: Provide the assets for clothes changer

garment_file_path.description:
The image of the outfit. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

garment_type.description:
Type of clothing item to swap. If not provided, swaps the entire outfit. 
* `upper_body` - for shirts/jackets 
* `lower_body` - for pants/skirts 
* `dresses` - for entire outfit (deprecated, use `entire_outfit` instead) 
* `entire_outfit` - for entire outfit

person_file_path.description:
The image with the person. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

name.description: Give your image a custom name for easy identification.

name: ai_clothes_changer_create_image

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the image. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the image(s), credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the image. Use it with the [Get image Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/image-projects/get-image-details) to fetch status and downloads.
